summary.short: Requires covered entities, in their health programs and activities, not to discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age or disability through patient care decision support tools, and to make reasonable efforts to identify and mitigate such risk from tools using those input variables.
summary.long: This excerpt of 45 CFR § 92.210 (the registry title describes it as part of the Section 1557 final rule) has three paragraphs. Paragraph (a) provides that a covered entity must not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability in its health programs or activities through the use of patient care decision support tools. Paragraph (b) imposes an ongoing duty to make reasonable efforts to identify uses of such tools that employ input variables or factors measuring those characteristics. Paragraph (c) requires reasonable efforts to mitigate the risk of discrimination resulting from the use of each tool identified under paragraph (b). The provisions address covered entities. The excerpt does not define covered entity or patient care decision support tool, does not state an effective date or compliance deadline, and contains no enforcement, penalty or private right of action provisions.

notes: Excerpt covers 45 CFR 92.210 only (paragraphs (a) to (c)); the document gives no date, version or source URL. The excerpt names no other instrument and no public body.
